description: Causal claims strongest in abstract + results; soften to associative in discussion; speculative in outlook. Never strengthen hedge backward across sections.
Every number / abbreviation / gene / species / accession in entity_registry must appear byte-identically in every section that mentions it.
Numeric superscripts assigned in order of first mention; never reused; contiguous across sections.
First occurrence in the paper = full term + parenthetical abbreviation; later occurrences = abbreviation only. Cross-section identical.
SP001 / SP011 house style: methods is the final section written, after discussion.
First sentence of section N must reference the claim or entity that closed section N-1.
The same underlying claim receives the same hedge tier across abstract / intro / results / discussion; do not casually downgrade.
Every section's lead sentence must trace back to one item in logic_line or story_arc.
Numerals 10+ (Arabic), 1-9 spelled out (per R023); consistent within and across sections.
Citation density: intro 5-10/section, results 0-2 (own data), discussion 1/paragraph.
